offering.name: IBM WebSphere Application Server (ILAN)
offering.description: IBM WebSphere Application Server (ILAN) is a no cost, non-supported and non-warranted version of WebSphere Application Server traditional. WebSphere Application Server is the leading open standards-based application foundation, offering accelerated delivery of innovative applications and unmatched operational efficiency, reliability, administration, security, and control. This edition delivers the latest in Java standards, which are certified to the Java EE 7 Web Profile and Java EE 7 full platform and supports their deployment for small-scale production of up to a total of 2GB heap size across all instances of application servers for the licensee.

feature.name: EJBDeploy tool for pre-EJB 3.0 modules
feature.description: Before you deploy applications on the server, you must run the EJBDeploy tool on the applications that contain EJB modules. Running the EJBDeploy tool generates deployment code for enterprise beans in the application. Beginning with the EJB 3.0 specification, the EJBDeploy tool is no longer required because WebSphere Application Server uses a new feature called "JITDeploy" which automatically generates code when the application starts; therefore, eliminating the need for the EJBDeploy tool. However, the tool is still available with WebSphere Application Server for applications with modules that are based on specifications prior to EJB 3.0.

feature.name: Stand-alone thin clients and resource adapters
feature.description: IBM thin clients provide a set of clients for a variety of technologies, such as JAX-WS, JAX-RPC, JAX-RS, XML, EJB, JPA, JMS, and more. IBM resource adapter provides the resource adapter for JMS. See the online product documentation for a complete listing of all thin clients and resource adapters.

feature.name: Embeddable EJB container
feature.description: The embeddable EJB container is a JAR file that you can use to run enterprise beans in a stand-alone Java Platform, Standard Edition environment. You can run enterprise beans using this embeddable container outside the application server. The embeddable EJB container is a part of the EJB 3.1 specification and is primarily used for unit testing enterprise beans business logic. See the online product documentation for more details about using and configuring the embeddable EJB container.

feature.name: Sample applications
feature.description: The Samples include both source code files and integrated enterprise applications that demonstrate some of the latest Java (TM) Platform, Enterprise Edition (Java EE) and WebSphere technologies. The samples are recommended for installation to learning and demonstration environments, such as development environments. However, they are not recommended for installation to production application server environments.

offering.name: IBM SDK, Java Technology Edition, Version 8
offering.description: IBM SDK, Java Technology Edition, Version 8 provides a full-function Java software development kit (SDK) that is compliant with Oracle Java Platform, Standard Edition (Java SE) 8 application programming interfaces (APIs). With IBM SDK, Java Technology Edition you can develop, test, and deploy applications at the Java 8 API level. The SDK contains the runtime environment, which allows users to run Java applications, as well as additional developer tools for creating Java applications.
